Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_Enabled_tooltip: Turns Enshrouded Sleep on or off. When some, but not all, living players are asleep, the mod speeds up world/calendar time in proportion to the fraction of players sleeping by reducing MinutesPerDay. It does not globally speed up movement, combat, zombies, vehicle physics, animations, or ordinary timed actions. When everyone living is asleep, Enshrouded Sleep restores the normal day length and lets vanilla Project Zomboid handle full-sleep fast-forward. Turning this off restores the captured native MinutesPerDay baseline.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_PartialSleepSpee: Fine-tunes partial-sleep acceleration; it does NOT replace the normal sleeping-player ratio. The mod first reads the server FastForwardMultiplier, multiplies it by this value, and then multiplies by SleepingPlayers / LivingPlayers. Formula: CalendarCompressionFactor = max(1, FastForwardMultiplier × PartialSleepSpeedScale × SleepFraction). 1.0 uses the normal proportional calculation, 0.5 makes partial-sleep acceleration half as strong, 2.0 makes it twice as strong, and 0.0 disables extra partial-sleep calendar compression. This setting has no effect when everyone is asleep because vanilla full-sleep behavior takes over.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticsEnabl: Support and development option. When enabled, Enshrouded Sleep records frequent detailed clock, sleep, CharacterStat, Moodle, nutrition, injury, and other diagnostic telemetry on the server and/or clients. This can make log files grow very quickly. Ordinary sleep/wake roster transitions are logged at low volume even when this option is off, so leave verbose diagnostics disabled during normal play unless troubleshooting a specific problem.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticForced: Forced calendar compression factor (SERVER TEST ONLY)

Controlled diagnostic tool; not a gameplay setting. It only operates when verbose diagnostics are enabled, exactly one living player is connected, and that player remains awake. A value above 1 forces MinutesPerDay to the native baseline divided by this factor so time-domain behavior can be tested without another player sleeping. If the player sleeps, another living player connects, or the test conditions otherwise stop matching, the override is suspended and native MinutesPerDay is restored. Keep this at 1.0 during normal play.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticAwakeP: Experimental SPIKE-006 development switch; not intended for a normal server. When verbose diagnostics and the one-player forced-compression test are both active, the prototype attempts to normalize the awake test player's hunger, thirst, fatigue, calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, and weight progression toward the rate expected at the server's native day length. It intentionally mutates the test character's survival state. Leave disabled except during the documented SPIKE-006 validation procedure.
